title: Sources Sought/RFI - AFLCMC/ESAN FMS Brazil Radar Modernization
description: This is a combined Sources Sought/Request for Information (RFI) notice. Any information submitted by respondents to this request is strictly voluntary. All information received from this Sources Sought/RFI notice will be used for planning and market research purposes only. The United States (U.S.) Government will treat your response to this Sources Sought/RFI notice as information. The information provided may be used by the Air Force to develop an acquisition strategy, statement of work (SOW), statement of objectives (SOO), and performance work statement (PWS) and associated specifications. Respondents are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this Sources Sought/RFI notice; all costs associated with responding to this Sources Sought/RFI notice will be solely at the interested parties� expense. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Respondents are advised that the Government is under no obligation to provide feedback with respect to any information submitted. To the maximum extent possible, please submit non-proprietary information. Any proprietary information submitted should be identified as such and will be handled accordingly and protected from disclosure. Proprietary information will be safeguarded in accordance with the applicable Government regulations. The Government shall not be liable for damages related to proprietary information that is not properly identified. Any submissions in response to this Sources Sought/RFI constitutes consent for that submission to be reviewed by Government personnel and Advisory & Assistance Services (A&AS) Contractor employees supporting AFLCMC/ES. The responses may be forwarded to other Government entities in consideration for applicability to other programs. All Government and Department of War (DoW) contractor personnel reviewing Sources Sought/RFI responses will have signed non-disclosure agreements and understand their responsibility for proper use and protection from unauthorized disclosure of proprietary information. All members of the Government and contractor team will be reminded of their obligation to protect such information to the maximum extent permitted or required by the Economic Espionage Act, 18 United States Code (U.S.C.) 1831 et seq., and other applicable statutes or regulations. In addition, Government members will be reminded of their obligation to afford protection under the Trade Secrets Act, 18 U.S.C. 1905. 1.0 Introduction The Aerospace Management Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Branch (AFLCMC/ESAN) is seeking market information to identify highly mobile, production-ready, commercial solutions to support the modernization of Ground Control Approach (GCA) and Precision Approach Radar (PAR) systems capabilities in support of the Brazilian Air Force and potentially other FMS partner nations. 2.0 Objective The primary objective of this Sources Sought/RFI notice is to identify new systems to replace existing L3Harris GCA-2000 and PAR-2000 systems to improve the Brazilian Air Force�s ability to support radar surveillance and precision landing operations. Based on the review of responses to this Sources Sought/RFI notice, the Government may elect to release a formal Request for Proposal (RFP) at a future date. The Period of Performance (PoP) for any subsequent contract effort will remain variable and dependent upon the maturity and deployment timelines of the offered solutions. Under any future resultant contract, the prime contractor will be required to execute a comprehensive modernization effort, to include the delivery of all required radar equipment, provision of initial spares, and the execution of all necessary site modifications and system integration. 3.0 Desired Capabilities The below capabilities integrate specific parameters required by the Brazilian Air Force. 3.1 General System must demonstrate the capability to achieve full flight inspection certification (FAA/ICAO standards) for both Airport Surveillance Radar (ASR) and Precision Approach Radar (PAR) functions. 3.2 Transportation a. Threshold (T): Setup within 8 hours by 4 personnel. Transportable by KC-390 aircraft. b. Objective (O): Setup within 4 hours by 2 personnel. Roll-on/Roll-off capable on KC-390 with zero major disassembly. 3.3 Equipment Specifics 3.3.1 Surveillance a. Primary Surveillance Radar (PSR) Range & Altitude Threshold (T): Minimum range of 30 NM. Altitude coverage up to 10,000 ft AGL. Objective (O): Minimum range of 60 NM. Altitude coverage up to 18,000 ft AGL. b. PSR Probability of Detection (T): 80% or higher. (O): 90% or higher for a 2m2 target. c. Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR) Range & Altitude (T): Minimum range of 60 NM and altitude coverage up to 18,000 ft AGL. (O): Range of 100 NM and altitude coverage up to 35,000 ft AGL. d. SSR Modes & Capability (T): Must support ATCRBS, Modes 3/A, C, S, and ADS-B. (O): Full support for all Threshold modes plus native cryptographic integration for secure military Mode 5 e. SSR Probability of Detection (Pd) (T): 90% or higher. (O): 95% or higher. 3.3.2 Precision Landing a. PAR Coverage & Switch Time (T): Service up to 6 runways, switchable within 60 seconds. (O): Service > 6 runways, switchable in under 30 seconds. b. PAR Instrumented Range (T): Reliable azimuth/elevation tracking and detection out to a minimum range of 10 NM. (O): Reliable azimuth/elevation tracking and detection out to 20 NM or greater. c. PAR Target Capacity (T): Track up to 50 aircraft in azimuth and 22 aircraft in elevation. (O): Track over 100 combined aircraft simultaneously. d. PAR Detection Probability (2m� target) (T): 90% probability at 10 NM. (O): 95% probability at 15 NM in rain and 20 NM in clear weather. e. PAR Resolution (T): Range: 400 ft, Azimuth: 1.2 degrees, Elevation: 0.6 degrees (all with greater than or equal to 80% probability). (O): Margins improved by 20% over threshold values. f. PAR Accuracy (T): Range: less than or equal to �100 ft (or 2%). Azimuth: less than or equal to �30 ft. Elevation: less than or equal �20 ft. (O): Margins improved by 20% over threshold values. 3.3.3 Communications Data Interoperability (T=O): Output standard ASTERIX Eurocontrol data format for all surveillance outputs. ATC Positions, Display, & Automation (T): Two (2) ATC positions. Explain and provide detailed documentation of the proposed a. ATC automation/display system. (O): Fully modular system expandable up to six (6) ATC positions. ATC Radio Communications (T): Each ATC position must have UHF/VHF transmit/receive capability and the ability to simultaneously monitor UHF/VHF Guard frequencies. (O): Fully integrated voice switch system with secure, encrypted transmit/receive capability. 3.3.4 System Reliability & Redundancy (T=O): Backup PSR transmitter or redundancy in the system is required. Backup power (UPS) is required. Mean Time Between Critical Failure (MTBCF) > 2,000 hours. 3.3.5 Maintainability (MTTR) (T): Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) < 30 minutes. (O): Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) < 15 minutes. 3.3.6 System Operational Certifications Identify whether or not the system has any/all of six (6) certifications for operations in both CONUS and OCONUS: Air Traffic Control Radar Beacon System (ATCRBS) Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) Mark XII System (AIMS); Cybersecurity; Interoperability and Supportability (I&S); National Airspace System (NAS); Spectrum; and Transportability (air, ground and sea). 3.3.7 Ancillary & Support Equipment Requirements (T): Identify all generators, environmental control unit (ECU), hardware/software, and ancillary equipment requirements necessary to support standalone system operations. (O): Offer integrated, self-contained auxiliary systems that minimize external logistics footprint and setup time. 3.4 Maintenance Capabilities a. title: Encroachment Management Implementation and Mission Readiness, Sustainment, and Compatibility Services AE IDIQ, Unrestricted
description: THIS IS AN UNRESTRICTED PROCUREMENT. This procurement will result in one Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract for multi-discipline Architect-Engineer (A-E) services for Encroachment Management Implementation and Mission Readiness, Sustainment, and Compatibility services at various Navy and Marine Corps installations primarily in the Navy Region Southwest but may also include work worldwide. These services will be procured in accordance with 40 USC Chapter 11, Selection of Architects and Engineers, as implemented by FAR 36. The IDIQ contract will be for a base period of two (2) years and three (3) one-year option periods (if exercised). The total fee for the contract term shall not exceed $30,000,000. The guaranteed minimum for the contract term (including option years) is $1,000. Firm-fixed price task orders will be negotiated for this contract. The minimum value of individual task orders executed under this contract is $25,000. The maximum value of individual task orders executed under this contract is $2,500,000. There will be no dollar limit per year. Estimated start date is March 2027. The Small Business size standard classification is North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) Code 541330 (Engineering Services). The Government seeks the most highly qualified firm to perform the required services, based on the demonstrated competence and qualifications, in accordance with the selection criteria. Primary A-E Services: 1. Land Use Planning. 2. Air Installations Compatible Use Zones (AICUZ) and Range Air Installations Compatible Use Zones (RAICUZ) Studies. 3. Encroachment Action Plans (EAP) or Encroachment Control Plans (ECP). 4. Strategic Engagement and Communication Plans (SECP). 5. Outreach Planning Materials. 6. Electronic Database. Secondary Services: 1. Other related studies/analysis: Provide additional services to assist in implementation of encroachment management studies, Range Complex Management Plans (RCMP), Integrated Natural Resource Management Plans (INRMP), Readiness and Environmental Protection Integration (REPI) Program plans, and other special planning, engineering, and encroachment support deliverables, such as analytical assessments, geospatial analysis and simulations, traffic studies, glint/glare analysis, radar assessments, plume analysis and modeling, lighting studies, and socio-economic studies. 2. Other Related Reports or Documentation: Deliverables also include assistance with incidental services related to providing public notice for studies and publicizing and providing training on encroachment-related studies. Please see attached synopsis for full synopsis description/instructions.

title: 58--OLES LONG RANGE MWIR THERMAL BINOCULARS
description: The Department of the Interior, Bureau of Land Management (BLM), intends to award a sole-source contract to Teledyne FLIR for three Recon HD high-definition, dual-sensor long-range thermal binocular/camera systems with 2� doubler lenses. BLM Law Enforcement currently utilizes legacy Teledyne FLIR Recon long-range, cooled mid-wave infrared (MWIR) thermal systems in remote and austere environments. These systems support law-enforcement missions including suspect detection and identification, detection of small unmanned aircraft systems (sUAS), operational overwatch, search-and-rescue, evidence collection, and reconnaissance. The requirement is for a Section 889-compliant, long-range, lightweight thermal system that integrates a low-light visible camera with a cooled MWIR imager and provides a high-definition 1280 � 720 thermal sensor, High Operating Temperature (HOT) MWIR cryo-cooled focal plane array, 8-micron pixel pitch, and 2� doubler lens. The Recon HD also provides long-range detection capabilities, including specified vehicle detection to 9,700 meters and human detection to 3,900 meters. Based on market research, BLM has identified the Teledyne FLIR Recon HD as the only Section 889-compliant solution that meets BLM's requirements for a long-range, high-definition, cooled MWIR thermal binocular/camera system and interfaces with existing field equipment. BLM intends to pursue this acquisition on a sole-source basis under the authority applicable to only one source being reasonably available. Response to Notice All responsible sources may submit a quotation or capability information demonstrating their ability to satisfy the Government's requirement, which will be considered by the agency. Responses shall be submitted electronically before the end of this announcement period. title: Germany – Construction work for swimming pool – Sorpesee GmbH - Energetische Sanierung Hallenbad Sundern | Holz BHKW
description: Die Sorpesee GmbH beabsichtig, das Hallenbad in Sundern energetisch zu sanieren. Bei dem Gebäude handelt es sich um ein 1-geschossigen, teilweise (ca. 70%) unterkellerten Bau in massiver Bauart. Die Dachkonstruktion über dem Erdgeschoss ist in Holzbauweise (Binder) erstellt worden. Diese wurde als Pultdach (oberhalb der Schwimmhalle) und als Flachdach konzipiert. Oberhalb der Schwimmhalle befindet sich lediglich ein Revisionsgang zur Kontrolle der dort verbauten Lüftungstechnik. Unterhalb des Erdgeschosses allerdings sind ca. 70 % der Flächen unterkellert. Dort befindet sich die Heizungstechnik. Der Keller ist unbeheizt. • Bruttorauminhalt: 21.183 m³ • Bruttogrundfläche Erdgeschoss: 2.113 m² • Bruttogrundfläche Kellergeschoss : 1.304 m² • Nettogrundfläche nach DIN : 3.199 m² Im Vordergrund des Gebäudes und der Nutzung steht die Schwimmhalle selbst. Diese Halle besitzt eine Fläche von ca. 1.083 m². Bei der Bauaufgabe handelt es sich um die Modernisierung und energetische Sanierung des Hallenbads in Sundern sowohl der Fassade, des Daches, der inneren abgehängten Decke und Wandbekleidung als auch der Energieversorgung. Das Hallenbad aus dem Jahr 1975/76 bietet drei Schwimmbecken: ein 25 m langes Schwimmbecken mit höhenverstellbarem Boden, ein Springbecken mit einem 1- Meter, 3- Meter und 5-Meter Sprungturm sowie ein Kinderbecken. Das Hallenbad in Sundern liegt in der Berliner Straße 62 in 59846 Sundern. Vorliegend handelt es sich um Arbeiten zur die Erstellung einer pelletbetriebenen KWK Anlage mit einer Pelletkessel-Kaskade als zusätzliche Heizung für die Gebäudeheizung. Für die Beheizung des Gebäudes steht derzeit ein Gasbrennwertkessel und ein Gas BHKW bereit, diese verbleiben als Notkessel am Aufstellort. Dual zu dem Bestand wird im Nachbarraum die neue pelletbetriebene Heizungsanlage aufgebaut werden.

title: Germany – Environmental planning – Umweltfachliche Projektsteuerung - Bw 102, Ersatzneubau Vorpommernbrücke sowie Umbau L 22
description: Die Hanse- und Universitätsstadt Rostock, Tiefbauamt, plant den Ersatzneubau der Vorpommernbrücke (BW 102) im Zuge der L 22 über die Warnow. Im Ergebnis einer Machbarkeitsstudie wurde eine Vorzugsvariante entwickelt, die eine Warnowquerung aus 2 Teilbauwerken festlegt. In diesem Zuge sind die Verkehrsanlagen auf dem Bauwerk selbst sowie die auf beiden Seiten vorgelagerten Streckenabschnitte bis zu den Anschlussknoten West und Ost zu planen und zu erneuern. Dabei sind sowohl 2 KFZ- Fahrstreifen stadteinwärts und 2 KFZ- Fahrstreifen stadtauswärts als auch beidseitige Geh- und Radwege zu berücksichtigen. Die vorgesehene Planung der Maßnahme gliedert sich thematisch im Wesentlichen in 3 Teile: 1. die Planung eines neuen Teilbauwerkes Nord (ggf. zzgl. Moorbrücken Nord) mit den entsprechenden verkehrlichen Anbindungen an die benachbarten Knoten, 2. die Planung des Abbruches der Bestandsbauwerke (Vorpommernbrücke, Moorbrücken, Verkehrszeichenbrücke), 3. die Planung eines neuen Teilbauwerkes Süd (ggf. zzgl. Moorbrücken Süd) einschließlich der Planung einer Verkehrszeichenbrücke mit den entsprechenden verkehrlichen Anbindungen an die benachbarten Knoten. Im Rahmen des Vorhabens sind die umweltfachlichen Anforderungen aus Natur-, Arten-, Gewässer-, Boden-, Klima- und Immissionsschutz einschließlich aller daraus resultierenden Genehmigungs- und Nebenbestimmungen zu berücksichtigen.

title: Germany – Instruments for measuring electrical quantities – Development and Series Production of Current-to-Frequency Converters for SIS100
description: The international research facility FAIR (Facility for Antiproton and Ion Research) is currently under construction at the GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research. This project requires numerous different types of detectors for beam diagnostics, including ionization chambers and secondary electron emission monitors. A key component of the design for these detector types is the current-to-frequency converter (IFC), which is used to measure current signals in the nano- and microampere range. The required systems are distributed across the various accelerator facilities on the FAIR campus. Prototype versions of the IFCs have been in use at GSI for some time. As part of this call for proposals, the IFC hardware is to be gradually further developed for the FAIR parameters and, in a second step, produced in series. Under this call for proposals, the IFC hardware is to be further developed in stages to meet the FAIR parameters and, in a second phase, put into mass production. The IFC devices including power supply crates are to be offered in accordance with the specifications.

description: - Allgemeine Beschreibung: Die Wohnungsgesellschaft Erkner mbH als städtische Tochtergesellschaft der Stadt Erkner beabsichtigt, den Wohnblock Friedrichstraße 14-18 in 15537 Erkner grundlegend zu sanieren und zu modernisieren. Nach aktueller Kostenschätzung belaufen sich die Baukosten (KG 200-500 und 700) auf rund 8,8 Mio. EUR. Aufgrund der Komplexität der Planungsaufgaben, die neben der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung auch architektonische und statische Planungsleistungen erfordern hat sich der Auftraggeber entschieden, die Planungsleistungen an einen Generalplaner zu vergeben. - Umfang: Die Wohnfläche umfasst rund 3.053 m² mit 54 Wohneinheiten. - Projektkosten: Die Kostenschätzung beträgt rund 8.800.000 EUR (brutto) für KG 200-500 u. 700 gem. DIN 276. - Projektdauer: März 2027 bis Mai 2029 - Gegenstand des Auftrages: Generalplanung mit den Leistungen: - Objektplanung Gebäude und Innenräume (§ 34 HOAI 2021) - Fachplanung Tragwerk (§ 51 HOAI 2021) - Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung, Anlagengruppen 1- 5 (§ 53 HOAI 2021) - Objektplanung Freianlagen (§ 39 HOAI 2021) - Bauphysik (Wärmeschutz/ Energiebilanzierung und Bauakustik) (Anlage 1 HOAI 2021) - Tiefbauplanung - Brandschutzplanung Der Generalplaner soll unter Berücksichtigung der vorliegenden Planung alle Leistungsphasen gem. HOAI erbringen. Es ist eine Beauftragung in Leistungsabschnitten vorgesehen (Stufe 1: LPH 1-3, Stufe 2: LPH 4, Stufe 3: LPH 5-7, Stufe 4: LPH 8-9). Im Leistungsumfang des Generalplaners enthalten ist auch die vollständige Genehmigungsplanung und Bauantragstellung unabhängig von den Vorschriften der neuen Bauordnung. Der Auftraggeber geht davon aus, dass nachfolgende besondere und sonstige Leistungen erforderlich sind. Der Auftraggeber erwartet vom Auftragnehmer, dass der Auftragnehmer ihn berät und diese Leistungen selbst erbringt oder geeignete Nachunternehmer beauftragt. Besondere und sonstige Leistungen: - Brandschutzplanung (Vorplanung, Entwurfsplanung, prüf- und genehmigungsfähiges Brandschutzkonzept) AHO Heft 17, LPH 1-9 - Energiebedarfsausweis nach Baufertigstellung - Mitwirkung Mieterveranstaltungen - Wohnungsbegehungen mit Mietern - Fördermittelbegleitung projektbegleitend - Abwicklung der Ausschreibungen der einzelnen Gewerke über die e-Vergabeplattform des AGs - Zuarbeiten zur Modernisierungsankündigung und -umlage nach BGB - Baugrunduntersuchung - vollumfängliche Schadstoffuntersuchung ausgewählter Bauteile (Fensterbereich, Dach) - Baustoffliche und Baukonstruktive Untersuchungen (optional) - Bautechnische Untersuchung zur Loggiaverankerung - Begutachtung Loggiaauflager und Brüstungsgeländer - Schallimmissionsprognose, Ermittlung maßgeblicher Außenlärmpegel - Lüftungskonzept Bestand (optional) Der Auftraggeber hat bereits umfangreiche Umbau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen für den angrenzenden Wohnblock in der Friedrichstraße 10-12a im Jahr 2025 abgeschlossen. buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Administration, defence and social security services – 10030260-Appui à la valorisation des potentiels territoriaux pour un développement local inclusif dans le nord du Togo
description: The project "Integrated Territorial Development and Good Governance in Togo" is implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). It supports the Government of Togo in advancing decentralisation and territorial development in the regions of Kara and Savanes. Despite progress in decentralisation, regional and local authorities face persistent challenges in exercising transferred competences, delivering quality public services, mobilising local revenues and promoting inclusive local economic development. These constraints are compounded by poverty, climate change, demographic pressure and a fragile security context in northern Togo. The overall objective is to enable regional and local actors to harness the social and economic potential of their territories to improve living conditions in an equitable and sustainable manner. The project applies an integrated territorial development approach with capacity development at individual, organisational and institutional levels. It cooperates with national ministries (Ministry of Local Development, Ministry of Decentralisation, Ministry of Finance), regional councils and municipalities, the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (Agence nationale de formation des collectivités territoriales, ANFCT), the National Association of Municipalities (Faîtière des Communes du Togo, FCT), civil society organisations and private sector actors. To sustain decentralisation and territorialisation efforts, the project also aims at strengthening socio-economic resilience, in particular of communities in the Northen border regions, and provide economic perspectives, in particular for young people. Activities are structured around three complementary outputs: (1) Strengthening the capacities of regional and local authorities to implement transferred competences. (2) Improving collaboration between public institutions, local authorities, civil society and the private sector for inclusive and conflict-sensitive territorial development. (3) Strengthening transparent, participatory and accountable local public financial management. Innovative elements include municipal benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning, digital solutions for local governance, performance-based management and evidence-based decision-making. Gender equality, social inclusion (LNOB), climate resilience, conflict sensitivity and digitalisation are mainstreamed across all interventions to ensure sustainable and scalable results. The assignment targets 38 municipalities in Kara and Savanes through FCT and ANFCT, with a view to progressive replication towards all 117 municipalities. Benchmarking and peer learning will be designed, piloted and institutionalised to steer capacity development and foster continuous improvement. In addition, specialised technical assistance will complement these mechanisms across the three outputs, including support for implementing transferred competences, facilitating inclusive territorial collaboration and strengthening local public financial management (e. g. participatory budgeting, revenue mobilisation, transparency and anti-corruption), while ensuring digital solutions adhere to recognised standards and are interoperable with national ecosystems.

buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Business services: law, marketing, consulting, recruitment, printing and security – 10021316-Lot 1: Strengthening MSME Competitiveness, Market Access and Business Environment Reform in Benin
description: Benin's economy has experienced strong growth in recent years, with GDP growth estimated at around 6-7% annually. Nevertheless, this growth has not translated sufficiently into sustainable employment and income opportunities for the majority of the population. Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), which represent more than 95% of registered businesses in Benin, continue to face major structural constraints limiting their competitiveness, productivity and job creation potential. These constraints include limited access to finance and markets, low levels of innovation and digitalisation, weak managerial and technical capacities, insufficient quality infrastructure, and a mismatch between labour market needs and available skills. The project "Employment-oriented promotion of the competitiveness of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises" (ProPME 2) aims to improve the competitiveness of MSMEs in selected sectors and regions in Benin with a strong employment impact. The project focuses particularly on enterprises operating in the agri-food sector, renewable energies, crafts and services, as well as on strengthening entrepreneurial ecosystems and labour market intermediation structures. Particular attention is given to women-led enterprises and young entrepreneurs. The project contributes to Benin"s National Development Plan 2018-2025, the national SME promotion strategy and the national employment promotion strategy. It is implemented as part of the wider programme "Improvement of income and employment situation in Benin", jointly supported by German Development Cooperation through GIZ and KfW. In addition, the project supports the implementation of the Alliance for Product Quality in Africa (AfPQ), a multi-actor initiative implemented by GIZ and PTB to improve product quality and market access under the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). The module is structured around three main outputs: - Output 1 aims to strengthen the entrepreneurial, technical and market integration capacities of MSMEs through tailored training, coaching and quality management support. - Output 2 aims to improve the business environment and strengthen support institutions involved in MSME development, quality infrastructure and public-private dialogue. - Output 3 aims to improve labour market intermediation and the alignment between vocational training and the skills needs of MSMEs.

description: Benin's economy is experiencing sustained economic growth, with real GDP growth estimated at around 6.4 % in 2023 and projected to remain above 6 % over the coming years. However, this growth has not translated into sufficient decent employment opportunities for the majority of the population. Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), which represent more than 95 % of registered enterprises, continue to face structural constraints including low productivity, weak integration into markets and value chains, limited access to finance and skilled labour, insufficient digitalisation, and inadequate business support services. Women-led enterprises and enterprises located in northern regions are particularly affected by these challenges. The Government of Benin has adopted several national strategies to strengthen economic productivity, employment promotion and SME competitiveness, including the National Development Plan 2018-2025, the national SME promotion strategy, the national employment policy and the "Benin Alafia 2060" vision. In parallel, the country aims to strengthen labour market governance through improved labour market information systems and territorial employment promotion approaches. The Federal Republic of Germany supports Benin in the implementation of these reforms through, among others, the project "Employment-oriented promotion of the competitiveness of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises" (ProPME 2). The project aims to improve the competitiveness of MSMEs in selected sectors and regions with a positive impact on employment. It focuses on the food processing industry, renewable energies, crafts and services sectors, as well as employment promotion and labour market intermediation. The module is structured around three main outputs: Output 1 aims to strengthen the competitiveness and growth capacities of MSMEs through tailored support, coaching and training measures. Output 2 aims to improve framework conditions for MSMEs through strengthened cooperation mechanisms, institutional support and public-private dialogue. Output 3 aims to improve the conditions for the placement of qualified workers in MSMEs through strengthened employment governance, labour market intermediation and labour market information systems.

title: Denmark – Transport services (excl. Waste transport) – Transportstøtte til Forsvarets indsættelser
description: Nærværende udbud omhandler Transportstøtte til Forsvarets indsættelser globalt, herunder genforsyning. Aftalen skal dække alle transportmodaliteter dvs. vejtransport, lufttransport, søtransport og i mindre grad også jernbanetransport og kurertransport, samt multimodaltransport. Forsvaret har egne transportmidler, men ikke nok til at dække behovet. Aftalen er således et supplement til Forsvarets egne og Allieredes transportkapaciteter. Transporterne omhandler bl.a. (ej udtømmende): Transport af enhver form for militært og ikke-militært materiel, herunder klassificeret materiel (op til og med klassifikationsgraden ”HEMMELIGT” (HEM)), sensitivt materiel og farligt gods, herunder ITAR-regulerede transporter (”International Traffic in Arms Regulations”) m.v., samt transport af personel. Det vil være et krav, at leverandøren skal kunne varetage enhver nødvendig opgave forbundet med transporten samt tilhørende serviceydelser. Typen af opgaver der skal gennemføres er typisk transport til og fra nationale og internationale missioner, øvelser, transport for allierede nationer, samt transporter til katastrofeområder, nødhjælpsområder mv. Transportopgaver kan således inkludere transport i højrisikoområder f.eks. områder med krig eller krigslignende tilstande, områder med høj kriminalitet, områder påvirket af naturkatastrofer eller ekstreme vejrbetingelser. Transportbehovene varierer i størrelse og antal fra sendinger på enkelte småpakker til part og/eller full-loads, hvoraf en stor del er direkte leveringer ofte med specifikke krav til bl.a. tidspunkt, krav om stempling af dokumenter ved grænsepassage o.m.a. Forsvaret opererer globalt 24/7/365 og har behov for transportkapaciteter der understøtter dette. For at øge forsyningssikkerheden ønsker Forsvaret at indgå i et strategisk partnerskab med op til 3 leverandører i en kaskademodel. Strategisk partnerskab her forstået som et tæt samarbejde i forhold til planlægning, optimering og gennemførsel af transportløsninger inklusiv efterfølgende erfaringsopfølgning. Aktiv deltagelse forventes, primært fra den primære leverandør i kaskaden, også med kort varsel, i bl.a. (ej udtømmende): Forsvarets interne stabsmøder og arbejde med udveksling af viden omkring specifikke destinationer, transportmåder og transportløsninger inklusiv efterfølgende erfaringsopfølgning til brug for udvikling af fremtidige transportløsninger, vidensindhentning på installationer både i og udenfor Danmark, trusselsvurderinger, beredskabsplanlægning mv. Aftalen indeholder derfor krav om at leverandøren stiller med et dedikeret team, og at både deltagere i teamet og leverandørens lokation, hvorfra teamet arbejder, kan sikkerhedsgodkendes. Øvrige leverandører i kaskaden skal også kunne agere strategisk partner i det omfang det skønnes nødvendigt. Den praktiske dag til dag håndtering, administration og kontakt til leverandøren, forventes at blive varetaget af Joint Movement and Transportation Organization (JMTO), der er ansvarlig for planlægning, organisering og gennemførsel af transport for det danske Forsvar. Det må forventes at en medarbejder fra det dedikerede team, som udgangspunkt, skal have en arbejdsdag om ugen hos JMTO. Udbuddet omfatter transporter globalt, men rent historisk har følgende områder haft, eller må forventes at få, en betydelig aktivitet under aftalens løbetid: Europa, Nordatlanten (især Grønland, Island og Færøerne - herunder krav til levering af transport med STOL-fly (Short Take Off and Landing)), Mellemøsten, USA og Afrika. Indenfor regionerne er der specifikke krav til transportydelserne, som vil fremgå af det senere udbudsmateriale. Udbuddet omfatter også alle nødvendige transportrelaterede services, f.eks. (ej udtømmende): Alle former for håndteringsservices, generel rådgivning og support, tillægsydelser der relaterer til de ovenfor nævnte transportområder, adgang til håndteringsudstyr til lastning/losning, assistance med toldbehandling og andre områder indenfor told, 24/7/365 hotline til det dedikerede team, om-pakning og dokumentering af farligt gods, logistiske tillægsløsninger f.eks. fremskaffelse af faciliteter såsom kontor, midlertidig lagre, korttidsleje af container osv. Det danske Forsvar er en aktiv del af ”Movement Coordination Center Europe” (MCCE), og Danmark tilbyder derigennem at udføre transportløsninger for allierede nationer. Disse transporter skal ligeledes kunne gennemføres under denne aftale. Danmark har også en international forpligtigelse til at understøtte allierede nationer under deres ophold i og/eller i transit gennem Danmark (Host Nation Support (HNS)). Under denne aftale skal leverandøren kunne understøtte det danske Forsvar med ydelser og materiel til at opfylde denne forpligtigelse. Der vil kunne opstå behov for transporter fra alle divisioner under det danske forsvarsministerium, Beredskabsstyrelsen, Rigspolitiet, FN og andre allierede m.fl. Aftalen forventes som nævnt indgået med op til 3 leverandører i en kaskade. Princippet for kaskaden forventes at være som følger: Leverandøren med det økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud (Leverandør nr. 1) vil, som udgangspunkt, få muligheden for at udføre alle ordrer under denne aftale før en ordre eventuelt bliver videregivet til Leverandør nr. 2 og alternativt Leverandør nr. 3. Det er forventeligt, at Leverandør nr. 1 kan løse 100% af opgaverne. I særlige tilfælde, f.eks. ved et markant øget behov for tung transport og/eller en aktivering af en større beredskabsplan, skal alle leverandører i kaskaden (under ledelse af JMTO) kunne samarbejde, såfremt dette vurderes nødvendigt, om at fremskaffe det nødvendige kapacitetsbehov. Henset til udviklingen i den geopolitiske situation mv., må det forventes at der gennem aftalens løbetid vil opstå behov for nye ydelser (f.eks. nye fokusområder, ruter, services mm.). Sådanne ydelser skal anses for omfattet af dette udbud i det omfang der er tale om ydelser i relation til understøttelse af Forsvarets behov for civil global transportstøtte.

title: USACE SPK MOTCO Facilities and Utilities Maintenance Services - Concord, California
description: This Sources Sought Notice is being issued for market research purposes to determine the availability, capability, and interest of 8(a) small business firms for a potential Government requirement which the Government intends to compete as a competitive 8(a). NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE. Requests for the solicitation will go unanswered. No award will be made from this Notice. Responses will be used to determine potential acquisition strategies, understand current market capabilities, and to gain knowledge of potential sources. GENERAL SCOPE:The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Sacramento District (SPK) anticipates a potential requirement for facilities and utilities maintenance services at U.S. Army Military Ocean Terminal Concord (MOTCO) in Concord, California. USACE SPKs intent is to solicit and award a competitive 8(a) small business requirement.Project Description: This is a non-personal services project to provide Facilities and Utilities Maintenance at U.S. Army Military Ocean Terminal Concord (MOTCO) across the following functional areas: Maintenance Management Services, Electrical Plants and Distribution Systems, Water Distribution Systems, Wastewater Systems, Stormwater Systems, Fire Protection Systems, Buildings and Structures and Installed Equipment, Pest Management, Roads and paved surfaces, Pier Maintenance and various miscellaneous maintenance requirements, and repair requirements including minor construction in accordance with the Performance Work Statement. The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, other items, and non-personal services. The Contractor is fully responsible for provisioning all parts required to execute both Preventive Maintenance Orders (PMOs) and Demand Maintenance Orders (DMOs). The potential requirement may result in a firm-fixed-price solicitation with a 6-month or 12-month to include one month Phase-in Period for the base period with four 1-year option periods. The Government intends to issue the solicitation on or around November 2026. If solicited, the Government intends to award the anticipated requirement by approximately June 2027. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for the potential requirement is anticipated to be 561210, Facilities Support Services. The small business size standard for the NAICS, as established by the U.S. Small Business Administration, is $47,000,000 annual revenue. The Product Service Code for the potential requirement is anticipated to be M1AZ, Operation of Other Administrative Facilities and Service Buildings.Contractors with the skill, capabilities, workload capacity, and ability to obtain bonding to complete the project described above (either through self-performance and/or Subcontractor management) are invited to provide capability statements to the primary point of contact listed below. Other than small businesses are also encouraged to submit Capability Statements.CAPABILITY STATEMENT:Industry is highly encouraged to fill out the market survey form at: MOTCO Facilities and Utilities Maintenance Services - Prefilled formResponses will not be considered an offer, proposal, or bid for any solicitation that may result from this Notice. Moreover, responses will not restrict the Government to an acquisition approach. This Notice is for information and planning purposes only. Respondents will not be notified of the results of any review conducted or the capability statements received. Please provide responses with the above link or submit questions by e-mail to the Contract Specialist, Melita Doyle, at (Melita.S.Doyle@usace.army.mil) by 1400 / 2:00 P.M. (Pacific Time) 08 October 2026. Please include the Sources Sought Notice number W9123826X1CDK in the e-mail subject line.

title: MABSM Sustainment & Implementation Services Sources Sought
description: Notice: This is not a solicitation but rather a Sources Sought Synopsis to determine potential sources for information and planning purposes only. The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine if responsible sources exist, to assist in determining if this effort can be competitive and/or a total Small Business Set-Aside. PLEASE SEE ADDITIONAL ATTACHMENTS FOR FURTHER DETAILS AND VENDOR CAPABILITY QUESTIONS Program Details: The MABSM application is a highly customized, mission-critical Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) system. Originally built on a baseline commercial Impresa MRO/ERP software foundation, the system has undergone extensive, continuous customization over the past 24 years. To date, the MABSM baseline includes over 242,000 custom code changes, program specifications, testing criteria, and complex interface logic. These modifications enable real-time communication with 17 legacy Department of Defense (DoD) systems. This highly specialized, proprietary configuration of the COTS software bears little structural resemblance to its commercial progenitor and operates as a unique hybrid system. MABSM operates and is sustained within the Department of the Air Force's Cloud 1 enterprise cloud environment, leveraging DoD Impact Level 4/5 (IL4/IL5) secure cloud infrastructure. Sourcing specialized contractors who can operate seamlessly within Cloud 1's DevSecOps frameworks, managed services, and security boundaries is crucial to system stability. MABSM dictates the real-time tracking of critical assets, including aircraft parts, financial transactions, and Nuclear Weapons-Related Material (NWRM) items. Due to the high-tempo depot environments in which it is deployed, the system requires a performance baseline exceeding 95% system uptime and near-zero code degradation. Furthermore, national security mandates dictate 100% real-time accountability of NWRM items within any given 24-hour period. Instructions: The Government requests interested parties provide the following information (please limit your response to no more than 10 pages): Company Name and Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code. The NAICS Code selected for this potential requirement is 541513 or 541519, which has a size standard of $37M or $24M. If you disagree that 541513 or 541519 is the proper NAICS Code, please submit that comment to the requiring activity along with what NAICS Code you believe this should be classified under; however, please do not wait for an amendment to this request. The due date for the market survey will remain at 08 October 2026. This date will not be extended. Provide any authorized distributor letters as necessary for non-manufactured items that state you are authorized distributors for Hill AFB, Utah. You are encouraged to provide any documentation to support your business�s capability in meeting the requirements. Failure to provide this type of documentation may result in the Government being unable to adequately assess your business�s capabilities to supply MABSM Sustainment and Implementation services. title: Government is conducting market research to identify qualified commercial HVAC contractors.
description: The Government is conducting market research to identify qualified commercial HVAC contractors capable of providing an HVAC solution for an existing facility. The Government's objective is to maximize use of existing building infrastructure where technically feasible rather than perform unnecessary demolition or complete replacement. Interested contractors should have experience evaluating existing HVAC infrastructure and developing retrofit solutions that may incorporate or interface with existing ductwork, electrical systems, controls, structural components, roof/wall penetrations, condensate systems and mechanical spaces. Contractors should be capable of conducting a site survey and recommending a technically acceptable solution that addresses equipment sizing, zoning, energy efficiency, compatibility with existing systems, controls integration, installation requirements and long-term maintainability.

title: Sources Sought: T-38 Side Brace Trunnion Assembly (PN: 202607928-10)
description: 1.0 Description / Background The Government is conducting market research to identify interested and capable sources for the manufacturing of the T-38 Side Brace Trunnion Assembly, Part Number (PN) 202607928-10. The T-38 side brace trunnion is a critical subcomponent of the aircraft's main landing gear. It serves as a primary structural support during landing and other operational loads, enabling the main landing gear to fully extend and retract. This part is specific to the T-38 aircraft operational envelope. Please note: A formal Technical Data Package (TDP) is not yet available, as the drawings are in the final stages of approval. Specific quantities and delivery schedules have not yet been determined. 2.0 Required Capabilities To be considered a capable source for this requirement, respondents must demonstrate the ability to meet the following critical parameters: Manufacturing Equipment: Minimum 5-axis CNC machining capability. Material Sourcing & Machining: Capability to procure and machine Aluminum 7050-T7451. Precision Tolerances: Capability to machine contours and radii to tight tolerances, as small as 0.001 inch. Size Envelope: Capability to machine a part with an overall envelope of approximately 2 feet in length and 7 inches in diameter. CAD/CAM Utilization: Capability to utilize a SolidWorks .SLDPRT file to generate machining profiles. Special Processes: Capability to perform (or utilize an approved subcontractor for) the following post-machining processes: Shot peen Anodize Fluorescent penetrant inspection Certifications: Contractors and any utilized subcontractors must comply with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements. 3.0 Submission Instructions Interested parties who believe they possess the expertise and capabilities to fulfill this requirement are invited to submit a Capability Statement. The Capability Statement should be brief (no more than 5 pages) and must include: Company Information: Company Name, CAGE Code, UEI number, Point of Contact, address, phone number, and business size/socioeconomic status under the applicable NAICS code. Technical Capability: A summary of your company's capabilities specifically addressing each of the manufacturing and special process requirements listed in Section 2.0. Past Performance: Information on any past government or commercial contracts for parts involving similar materials, complexities, and manufacturing processes. 4.0 Disclaimer This Sources Sought notice is issued for informational and market research purposes only. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. This notice does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Respondents are advised that the Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice; all costs associated with responding will be solely at the interested party�s expense.

title: LITTORAL COMBAT SHIP (LCS) IN-SERVICE ENGINEERING & LIFE CYCLE SUPPORT
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD SOLE SOURCE. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. This is a notice of intent to solicit, negotiate and award a sole source contract under statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. Naval Surface Warfare Center Port Hueneme Division intends to award a sole source contract to General Dynamics Mission Systems, Inc. (GDMS) (CAGE 3CX85) for in-service engineering and lifecycle support of Command, Control, Computers, Communications, Combat Systems, and Intelligence (C5I) system elements of the Littoral Combat Ship (LCS) equipment specific to the Independence (INDY) variant. Services include engineering; design; integration; test and evaluation; software development, testing, and load; system upgrade/replacement planning onboard and at sites; logistics product development and distribution; configuration management of the systems and logistics products; as well as training systems. Market research indicates that GDMS, as the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the LCS INDY variant combat system, is the only source capable of satisfying the agency requirements. A Sources Sought Notice (N6339426R0TBD) was published to SAM.gov on 24 October 2025 to identify potential sources. The Government reviewed capability statements from 10 respondents and determined that GDMS is the only source capable of satisfying the agency requirements for this follow-on acquisition without unacceptable delays and substantial duplication of cost that is not expected to be recovered through competition. Transitioning this work to a non-OEM source without access to GDMS' proprietary design data, is estimated to result in duplicate costs of at least $26M-$34M and create an immediate, minimum five-year gap in critical engineering support. This is based on the need for a non-OEM source to design, construct, equip, and certify specialized testing and integration facilities to replicate the LCS INDY variant's unique computing environment; recruit, clear, and train a specialized nationwide workforce, and negotiate new subcontracts for proprietary OEM materials; reverse-engineer proprietary software interfaces and C5I integration nodes to perform the required lifecycle engineering; and complete rigorous land-based testing, at-sea trials, and formal Navy combat system safety certification necessary to obtain a Navy Authority to Operate. This notice of intent to award is not a request for competitive proposals; however, in accordance with FAR 5.101(c)(4)(vi), responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency. Responses may be submitted via email to john.t.peachey2.civ@us.navy.mil with a copy to wesley.m.whisner.civ@us.navy.mil. Please include Notice ID # N6339426R0TBD. The Government is not obligated to award, and will not pay for, any information received from potential sources because of this notice of intent.
